title: Dogfood LLM Gopher
summary: Use Gopher first for Gopher development. Record every material manual fallback caused by a missing or inadequate capability.
procedure: Open current context and relevant operation article.
Use examiner/rules/editor/test/package capabilities before ambient shell work.
If Gopher cannot perform or explain the task, record a dogfood escape before using the fallback.
Classify recurring escapes and add an article, rule, or bounded capability.
Re-run the original task through Gopher.
invariants: A fallback is evidence of a capability or guide gap, not merely an inconvenience.
Do not hide unsuccessful Gopher attempts when qualification depends on fallback work.
